entry.title: Infinite-Scrolling Logos In Flat HTML And Pure CSS
entry.summary: Remember the HTML `` element? It’s deprecated, so it’s not like you’re going to use it when you need some sort of horizontal auto-scrolling feature. That’s where CSS comes in because it has all the tools we need to pull it off. Silvestar Bistrović demonstrates a technique that makes it possible with a set of images and as little HTML as possible.

entry.title: Setting And Persisting Color Scheme Preferences With CSS And A “Touch” Of JavaScript
